name: ShadowKrypt
author: Devo Tafsin

sections.installation:
1. Upload the shadowkrypt folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate ShadowKrypt from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Open Settings from the ShadowKrypt row on the WordPress Plugins screen.
sections.description:
ShadowKrypt is a WordPress admin utility for hiding selected plugins and themes from dashboard lists while keeping them active and functional.

Features

  • Hide selected plugins from the Plugins screen.
  • Hide selected themes from theme listings.
  • Hide ShadowKrypt itself from the Plugins screen.
  • Choose whether visibility rules are kept or cleared when the plugin is deactivated.
  • Open settings directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  • Start from a modern welcome dashboard with quick stats and shortcuts.
  • Download installed plugins and themes as zip files from the native WordPress Plugins and Themes screens.
  • Monitor plugin and theme file changes from the Security menu.
  • Review suspicious administrator account activity.
  • Limit failed login attempts by IP address.
  • Check SMTP/mail setup from the SMTP Setup Checker menu.
  • Send a test email through WordPress.
  • Keep a failed email log for troubleshooting.
  • Scan plugin performance signals from the Performance menu.
  • Detect heavy plugins by size, file count, callbacks, and score.
  • Review WordPress Site Health checks inside ShadowKrypt.
  • Show live Performance Score and Health Score after checks run.
  • Optimise site speed from the Speed Optimisation menu with page cache, asset tuning, and image tweaks.
  • Launch the speed dashboard with an animated rocket preloader and Ultra Fast Mode.
  • Auto-save speed optimisation settings when toggles change.

Usage

Use ShadowKrypt to view the welcome dashboard.

Use ShadowKrypt > Hide Theme Plugin to control plugin and theme visibility.

Use Settings > After Deactivation to choose whether visibility rules should be kept or cleared when ShadowKrypt is deactivated.

Use ShadowKrypt > Security to monitor file changes, review administrator accounts, and enable login attempt limiting.

Use ShadowKrypt > SMTP Setup Checker to check mail setup, send a test email, and review failed email logs.

Use ShadowKrypt > Performance to scan plugin performance signals, detect heavy plugins, and review Site Health checks.

Use ShadowKrypt > Speed Optimisation to enable caching, asset tuning, image optimisations, and Ultra Fast Mode.

Use the main WordPress Plugins and Themes screens to download installed plugins and themes as zip files.

Version

Current version: 1.1.0

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6 or newer
  • PHP 7.4 or newer

License

GPL v2 or later.
